mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NO AS worker_no, U.USER_NAME AS name, U.USER_BUSO AS dept, U.USER_JICK AS rank, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), U.USER_JDATE, 120) AS joinDate, P.PE_EMAIL AS email, P.PE_BASE AS base, P.PE_MEAL AS meal, P.PE_POS AS pos, P.PE_CAR AS car FROM USERT U WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN PAYROLL_EMP P WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.PE_WORKER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE U.USER_RET = 0 ORDER BY U.USER_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYROLL_EMP (PE_WORKER_NO, PE_EMAIL, PE_BASE, PE_MEAL, PE_POS, PE_CAR) VALUES (#{worker_no}, #{email}, #{base,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{meal,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{pos,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{car,jdbcType=DOUBLE})
mapper.select: SELECT PM_IDX AS pm_idx, PM_YM AS ym, PM_WORKER_NO AS worker_no, PM_BASE AS base, PM_MEAL AS meal, PM_POS AS pos, PM_CAR AS car, PM_OT AS ot, PM_NIGHT AS night, PM_SAT AS sat, PM_SPEC AS spec, PM_BONUS AS bonus, PM_NPA AS npa, PM_HIA AS hia, PM_LTA AS lta, PM_EIA AS eia, PM_TAX AS tax, PM_LOCA AS loca, PM_YJ AS yj, PM_HS AS hs, PM_DED AS ded FROM PAYROLL_MONTH WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PM_YM = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYROLL_MONTH SET PM_BASE = #{base,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_MEAL = #{meal,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_POS = #{pos,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_CAR = #{car,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_OT = #{ot,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_NIGHT = #{night,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_SAT = #{sat,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_SPEC = #{spec,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_BONUS = #{bonus,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_NPA = #{npa,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_HIA = #{hia,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_LTA = #{lta,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_EIA = #{eia,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_TAX = #{tax,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_LOCA = #{loca,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_YJ = #{yj,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_HS = #{hs,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PM_DED = #{ded,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE PM_YM = #{ym} AND PM_WORKER_NO = #{worker_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYROLL_MONTH (PM_YM, PM_WORKER_NO, PM_BASE, PM_MEAL, PM_POS, PM_CAR, PM_OT, PM_NIGHT, PM_SAT, PM_SPEC, PM_BONUS, PM_NPA, PM_HIA, PM_LTA, PM_EIA, PM_TAX, PM_LOCA, PM_YJ, PM_HS, PM_DED) VALUES (#{ym}, #{worker_no}, #{base,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{meal,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{pos,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{car,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{ot,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{night,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{sat,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{spec,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{bonus,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{npa,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{hia,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lta,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{eia,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{tax,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{loca,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{yj,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{hs,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{ded,jdbcType=DOUBLE})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PAYROLL_MONTH WHERE PM_YM = #{ym} AND PM_WORKER_NO = #{worker_no}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYROLL_SENT SET PS_SENT_DATE = #{sentDate} WHERE PS_YM = #{ym} AND PS_WORKER_NO = #{worker_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYROLL_SENT (PS_YM, PS_WORKER_NO, PS_SENT_DATE) VALUES (#{ym}, #{worker_no}, #{sentDate})
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 PST_IDX AS pst_idx, PST_CO AS co, PST_FROM_EMAIL AS fromEmail, PST_FN AS fn, PST_MODE AS mode, PST_BCC AS bcc, PST_NP AS np, PST_HI AS hi, PST_LT AS lt, PST_EI AS ei, PST_TX AS tx, PST_MEAL AS mealLimit, PST_SMTP_HOST AS smtpHost, PST_SMTP_PORT AS smtpPort, PST_SMTP_USER AS smtpUser, PST_SMTP_PASS AS smtpPass FROM PAYROLL_SET WITH(NOLOCK) ORDER BY PST_IDX
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYROLL_SET (PST_CO, PST_FROM_EMAIL, PST_FN, PST_MODE, PST_BCC, PST_NP, PST_HI, PST_LT, PST_EI, PST_TX, PST_MEAL, PST_SMTP_HOST, PST_SMTP_PORT, PST_SMTP_USER, PST_SMTP_PASS) VALUES (#{co}, #{fromEmail}, #{fn}, #{mode}, #{bcc}, #{np,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{hi,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lt,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{ei,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{tx,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{mealLimit,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{smtpHost}, #{smtpPort,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{smtpUser}, #{smtpPass})
